caption: The drawing depicts an ornate hand fan composed of overlapping, feather-like segments arranged in a semi-circular shape. The segments are primarily shaded in tones of gray and are decorated with swirling yellow patterns. Some segments display fine detailing that resembles thin feathers, while the rightmost segment includes the outline of a bird in pale brown and white. The base of the fan features multiple thin sticks rendered in dark brown with intricate yellow-gold designs, converging at a small circular hinge with a yellow loop attached at the bottom. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the artist's name, "TULITA WESTFALL," is written in black ink in the lower right corner. The dimensions "15 x 20" are written in the lower left corner.
title: Feather Fan
